messages:
samir: anyone know where to find saved query presets for route+model filtering? trying to debug acme eu 5xx spike

devon: samir — saved views live in Log Explorer → Saved Views. quick link: https://console.redwood.internal/logs/views

samir: that link goes to a big list, any specific saved view name i should look for?

devon: look for "eu-gen-route-model-presets" or "ops:route-model-filters". if not there, create one. here's a quick query you can paste:
```
org:"acme"
route:"/v1/generate"
model:"zenith-gen"
region:"eu-west-1"
status:[500 TO 599]
| sort @timestamp desc
```

maria: added `eu-gen-5xx-acme` saved view just now and shared with eng-sre. devon, can you pin it to the team workspace?

logbot: Saved view "eu-gen-5xx-acme" created by maria (shared with eng-sre)

jess: can we also add p95 latency and kv-cache-miss flag to that view? quick snippet to add metric columns?

devon: yes — add columns `p95_ms`, `kv_cache_miss` in the columns dropdown. here's a shortcut query to compute p95:
```
stats pct(95, duration_ms) as p95_ms by route, model
```

rahul: FYI alert "eu-gen-5xx-threshold" is firing. i can lower the alert window from 5m->2m but want ops signoff. link: https://console.redwood.internal/alerts/eu-gen-5xx-threshold

maria: +1 from me. let's tweak to 2m and add the saved view link in the alert message for faster triage.

samir: thanks all — leaving a note in the runbook (docs/runbooks/observability.md) and adding the saved view link. thx :thumbsup:
